verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs directly state the capability — "Reproduce issues, narrow the root cause, and verify the fix" — and this is backed by concrete supporting features: agents can start dev servers, click through UI flows, and verify changes work before pushing a PR, producing screenshots/videos/logs as verification artifacts, plus Bugbot flagging bugs pre-merge and diff/check inspection tooling. Missing for 10: deeper first-party elaboration of the debugging/root-cause workflow itself (the doc citation is essentially a page title), and no independent/hands-on corroboration that this reproduce-diagnose-verify loop works well in practice.
